# libwebp

PNClip vendors Google libwebp 1.6.0 for still and animated WebP encoding.
The static libraries are universal macOS binaries containing arm64 and x86_64.

Windows builds use the unmodified official source archive `libwebp-1.6.0.tar.gz`
in this directory, compiled locally by CMake. No download is needed at build time.
Archive origin: https://storage.googleapis.com/downloads.webmproject.org/releases/webp/libwebp-1.6.0.tar.gz
SHA-256: `e4ab7009bf0629fd11982d4c2aa83964cf244cffba7347ecd39019a9e38c4564`.

Source and binary distributions:
https://developers.google.com/speed/webp/docs/precompiled

The upstream license and patent grant are included in `COPYING` and `PATENTS`.
